{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Ord Gertoth''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Re-Animated">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> Shortly before [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Droids Re-Animated]]'' places the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' adventure on [[R-Duba]] not long before their arrival on [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]], which is itself dated to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] by {{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}.</ref> the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] stowed away on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveling from [[R-Duba]] to Ord Gertoth, but the duo were kicked off at a [[Sindee's refueling station|one-woman refueling station]].<ref name="Re-Animated" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Gertoth was first mentioned in ''[[The Droids Re-Animated]]'', an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] for the [[StarWars.com]] blog.<ref name="Re-Animated" /> The article was finally released in [[2013]] after sitting in development hell for roughly a decade.<ref name="Sonko lives">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50797043|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-06-15|time=2:57 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180316143709/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a.50012958}}</ref> Peña and Handley had originally conceived of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] losing his [[Eye/Legends|eye]] during the "subjugation of Ord Gertoth," but when Screed's backstory was told in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', they salvaged the name "Ord Gertoth" as C-3PO and R2-D2's destination after leaving R-Duba.<ref name="subjugation">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50863647|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-07-15|time=1:59 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180316144023/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a.50012958/page-4#post-50863647}}</ref>
